3661-5006-8170-8249.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-5006-8170-8249.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Shield Sphere, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2301-3845-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-3845-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4068-4770-6006-6090.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4770-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1849-2023-4518-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4875-4881-6909-8198.manaNeeded: {4}{B}{G} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4875-4881-6909-8198.description:
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1322-3490-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
1322-3490-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3755-4687-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least three charge counters on it.
3755-4687-5479.description:
Activate Elven Chorus by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte two times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping two lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1981-2415-5231-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5231-7173.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

1017-5641-7687.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1017-5641-7687.description:
Draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

372-1621-3378.manaNeeded: {7}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1621-3378.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

4419-5641-7306.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that'll enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

671-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
671-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

2173-2469-5220-7286.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

4186-5789-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-5789-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

650-891-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

774-4543-5478.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}.
774-4543-5478.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trench Behemoth twice by returning two lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

1409-1780-6751.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve both Burdened Aerialist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2342-7070--141.easyPrerequisites: You are able to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more.
2342-7070--141.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the affinity creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Shaman en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to its affinity ability.
Repeat.
2342-7070--141.notes: You want to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more using its affinity ability. For example, if you choose Ancestral Statue, you need to control two or more attacking creatures.

436-5220-6472.description:
Cast Deceptive Frostkite by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Deceptive Frostkite into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Deceptive Frostkite dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Deceptive Frostkite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Deceptive Frostkite trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Deceptive Frostkite onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-1863-3875-5921-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1863-3875-5921-6756.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1651-1863-3875-5921-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

2821-5479-6702-6723.description:
Activate Kilo by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte by remove a charge counter from it, untapping Minamo.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

141-5231-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2438-4215-5630-6872.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Moss-Pit Skeleton.
When Moss-Pit Skeleton dies, Long Feng and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Moss-Pit Skeleton and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2999-3197-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-3197-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-4394-4875-5470.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ghired, adding {1}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1174-1479-4288.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-4288.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

3767-3918-4306-4452.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
3767-3918-4306-4452.notablePrerequisites:
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
Your devotion to any color is at least 3.
3767-3918-4306-4452.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color with which you have devotion.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1-2428-5636-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2428-5636-6282.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat.

942-2523-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Samwise the Stouthearted token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Samwise the Stouthearted token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-5263-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Ravenous Intruder abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

618-1938-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

401-862-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
401-862-4050.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, adding {1}.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Crimson Kobolds to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

215-851-3426-4050.description:
Cast Deranged Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Squirrels, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deranged Hermit to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1441-2906-4050-5270.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
1441-2906-4050-5270.description:
Cast Bill the Pony by paying {W}.
When Bill the Pony enters the battlefield, it and Samwise trigger.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Bill the Pony trigger, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bill the Pony, adding {W}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Bill the Pony to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

215-851-4050-4555-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Forests.
215-851-4050-4555-5176.description:
Cast Tangle Golem by paying {0}.
Radagast triggers, creating two 3/3 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Beasts, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Tangle Golem from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2233-3569-3983.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2233-3569-3983.description:
Cast Pollenbright Druid by paying {G}.
Pollenbright Druid enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Pollenbright Druid's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Pollenbright Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

914-3249-5147.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3249-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

2034-2471-5224.notablePrerequisites: Zabaz has at least one counter on it.
2034-2471-5224.description:
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Zabaz.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Zabaz, adding {C}{C}.
Zabaz dies, triggering its modular ability and Together Forever.
Resolve the Zabaz trigger, moving its +1/+1 counters onto another artifact creature.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Zabaz from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Zabaz by paying {1}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2744-2808-3122.description:
Cast Undercover Operative by paying {2}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Enduring Scalelord.
Undercover Operative enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Enduring Scalelord and Undercover Operative triggers.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Enduring Scalelord triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 4.

2730-3175-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan
Repeat.

2749-3350-4695.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers.
Activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, giving Wall of Blood +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until you have zero life.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
